review.head: 88ae2870cf57f6215d1dd0ab9351ed63b90cc8a8

axes.correctness: Checked joined authority fields against existing resolver status/expiry validation; preserves post-lock reread and reparent rejection. Empty and populated Couple overview retain response envelope, grant scope, pagination and Android rules.
axes.readability: New shared joined reader is 34 lines, explicit fixed fields and fixed table names. Diagnostics has documented bounded state and opt-in construction.
axes.architecture: Identity owns joined authority reads; no global relation-join behavior, domain API or migration changed. Frontend repositories untouched.
axes.security: Token hash remains parameterized. Schema identifier comes from factory configuration and is quoted. No cross-request authority cache. Concurrent revoke/disable/removal and expiry tests passed exact-head CI. Diagnostic aggregates retain no SQL or values.
axes.performance: Four round trips become one for actor resolution. Transaction controls, explicit authority lock ordering and refreshed authority are preserved. Live effect requires the pending same-topology measurement; diagnostics is disabled for the first comparison.

review.quality: Both existing exact-head CI jobs passed. No applied migration, test threshold, security policy or quality gate was weakened.
review.rollback: Previous successful Railway deployment b1b875c0-25d8-4bcf-a6fe-2484bbb25c74, source 5b2536212e9a6feafbb48d9a71bba1f90ded08ae, image sha256:d80e12f4f3b25da277b88f4138ac617cc0dee2024e7a645eb800e79781fac375 is recorded. This PR adds no migrations or monetary writes; redeploy the previous image/source if smoke checks fail or material regressions appear. Preserve all business history.

methodology: Sequential round-robin, one initial probe and twenty steady reads per route. Same synthetic fixture, supplied principals, origin, US West application placement and unchanged DB/configuration. Diagnostics disabled in both. Baseline collected booking families before Identity; candidate collected Identity before booking families. One before/after pair at different times, shared service: observed improvement, not a region experiment, causal isolation of all traffic or an SLO.
remaining: Assigned-Staff success still requires the event window. Live diagnostics/container DB attribution and region experiment remain incomplete. Synthetic accounting is not live payment evidence.
